segments.name: e1-open

params.title: Install Zodl and back up your phrase
params.line: Zodl was called Zashi in older guides

narration: By the end of this video, you will have a private Zcash wallet on your phone. Your recovery phrase will be safe on paper.

segments.name: e1-wallet
narration: First, what is a wallet? It is an app that holds your keys. Your keys let you spend your ZEC, the coin of Zcash.
You do not need an email address or a phone number. Only you control this wallet.

segments.name: e1-install
narration: We will use Zodl. Zodl is a Zcash wallet for your phone. Older guides call it Zashi.
Get Zodl from the App Store or the Play Store. On Android you can also use F-Droid or GitHub.

segments.name: e1-create
narration: Open Zodl and tap Create New Wallet.
That is it. Your home screen has four buttons: Receive, Send, Pay and Swap.

segments.name: e1-phrase
narration: Now the most important step. Your wallet has a recovery phrase. It is 24 words in a set order.
If you lose your phone, those words bring your wallet back on a new one.

segments.name: e1-backup

params.label: Diagram, not the app
rules: Never type it into a website
Nobody legitimate will ever ask for it

narration: Back it up right now. Open Advanced Settings, then tap Zodl Recovery Phrase.
Write the 24 words on paper, in order. Check every word twice.
Three rules. Keep it on paper. Never type it into a website. Nobody legitimate will ever ask for it, not even Zodl.

segments.name: e1-later
narration: When your first ZEC arrives, Zodl shows Wallet Backup Required.
Tap Start, then Next, then Reveal security details. Check the words against your paper, then tap I've saved it.

segments.name: e1-site
narration: Your wallet is set up. Tick Wallet setup on the site to track your progress.

segments.name: e1-end
narration: Next, episode 2: getting your first ZEC. Every step is at zero-to-shielded.vercel.app.

upload.description:
Set up a private Zcash wallet on your phone and back up your recovery phrase on paper. This is episode 1 of Zero to Shielded, five short videos that take you from no wallet to your first private payment.

Watch the series and tick your progress: https://zero-to-shielded.vercel.app

In this episode:
- What a wallet is: an app that holds your keys. You do not need an email address or a phone number.
- Where to get Zodl: the App Store or the Play Store. On Android you can also use F-Droid or GitHub.
- Open Zodl and tap Create New Wallet. Your home screen has four buttons: Receive, Send, Pay and Swap.
- Your recovery phrase: 24 words in a set order. If you lose your phone, those words bring your wallet back on a new one. Write them on paper in order. Check every word twice.
- The backup steps Zodl shows when your first ZEC arrives.

Chapters:
{chapters}

Wallet steps are shown as labelled step diagrams with the exact button names from the Zodl app, not as drawings of the app. Every fact is sourced in docs/FACTS.md. No recovery phrase appears on screen.

Zodl was called Zashi in older guides.

Zodl will never ask for your recovery phrase.

Zodl: https://zodl.com/
Zodl support: https://support.zodl.com/

Video, narration and script: CC BY-ND 4.0. Repost with credit, no edits.

Scripts, narration and editing were produced with AI assistance (Kiro). Narration is a synthesised voice (Kokoro, Apache-2.0). Music is original and generated in code.
